QUESTION_DRIVEN, single question carried over from the prior receipt FTR-20261023-42397075-01, which recorded this readout as unavailable: does TCF4 (TCF7L2) in the rescued WWOX-KO organoid return toward wild type. Scope read, and nothing else: the legend of preprint Fig. EV6 panel (F), the raster image of panel (F) itself, and — for identification only — the one Results sentence that cites it. No section of the preprint is claimed as read; coverage.figures = read refers to that single panel.

Identification of the panel across the two versions: the citing sentence is word-for-word identical in the preprint (derived layout text, lines 302-307) and in the published accepted manuscript (p. 9, lines 7-9) except for the figure label — 'we assessed Wnt pathway activity in WWOX-KO, WOREE, SCAR12, and rescued WWOX-KO organoids (Fig. EV6F / Supplementary Fig. 6F). Western blot analysis revealed elevated levels of TCF4 (TCF7L2)'. Same experiment, two labels; that identity is an inference from the two sentences, not a statement of the publisher.

Panel (F) as read, page 53 of the preprint PDF, the single embedded JPEG of the Fig. EV6 composite (858x885 px, embedded-image sha256 prefix e8ab1acc4e4894a9), re-rendered from the page at 1200 dpi over the panel-F clip: immunoblot, week 16 cerebral organoids, rows TCF-4 (~56 kDa), WWOX (46 kDa), GAPDH (36 kDa); six lanes, one per line, left to right JH-WT, WKO-1C, WKO-2C, SCAR12, WOREE, WKO-1C AAV9. Printed quantification beneath the lanes, normalised to JH-WT = 1: 1 / 1.4 / 1.3 / 1.7 / 3.1 / 0.3. The rescue arm is AAV9-WWOX in one knockout clone (WKO-1C), a precision the published body sentence ('rescued WWOX-KO organoids') does not carry.

No error bars, no statistics and no replicate count are shown for this panel; the legend declares no n for (F), and the mean +/- SEM and ANOVA sentence of the Fig. EV6 legend belongs to panel (B). Reading limit stated rather than smoothed: the GAPDH band in the WOREE lane is visibly lighter than its neighbours, which bears on the 3.1 figure; the lanes are single, so the six numbers are one blot, not a measured distribution.
